# Plagiarism Checker Ai MCP

> Check text similarity, analyze writing style consistency, verify citations, and generate original...

`plagiarism-checker-ai-mcp` is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by MEOK AI Labs.

## Install

```bash
pip install plagiarism-checker-ai-mcp
```

Or run without installing:

```bash
uvx plagiarism-checker-ai-mcp
```

## Tools

- `check_text_similarity` — Compare two texts for similarity using multiple algorithms.
- `analyze_writing_style` — Detect writing style characteristics and inconsistencies. Optionally compare against a reference text.
- `check_citation_completeness` — Verify that citations and references are properly formatted and complete. Styles: apa, harvard, ieee, any.
- `generate_originality_report` — Generate a full originality analysis report. Pass reference_texts as JSON array of strings.
